strings.Download script first to /tmp/install.sh: 先將腳本下載至 /tmp/install.sh 並閱讀，再執行 bash /tmp/install.sh；安裝會在無 root 權限時自動退回至 ~/.local

strings.Run install script to install ollaya to: 執行安裝腳本將 ollaya 安裝至 ~/.local
strings.expose models to AI agents via MCP serve: 透過 MCP server 將模型開放給 AI agent
